nodes.label: Space Agent
nodes.summary: Browser-first AI agent runtime whose agent can reshape the running interface.

nodes.label: Browser-first runtime
nodes.summary: Agent orchestration, prompts, state, tools, and UI behavior default to the browser layer.

nodes.label: Thin server infrastructure
nodes.summary: Server owns explicit infrastructure contracts such as auth, routing, API hosting, proxying, file access, and runtime state.

nodes.label: Layered customware model
nodes.summary: L0 firmware, L1 group customware, and L2 user customware define browser-delivered module and app-file ownership.

nodes.label: Module extension system
nodes.summary: Browser modules compose through explicit HTML seams, JS hooks, metadata manifests, context tags, and layered overrides.

nodes.label: Text-based agent skills
nodes.summary: Capabilities can live in SKILL.md files with metadata-driven discovery and optional prompt placement.

nodes.label: Prompt context system
nodes.summary: Promptinclude, memory, skills, context tags, and agent prompt modules shape agent runtime context.

nodes.label: Admin control plane
nodes.summary: Admin mode, route clamping, file/admin views, and server permissions provide a stable control plane.

nodes.label: Browser surface runtime
nodes.summary: The web_browsing module and desktop host provide registered browser surfaces, readable content, actions, focus, persistence, and desktop webview transport.

nodes.label: Local LLM runtime
nodes.summary: Hugging Face and WebLLM modules provide browser-only local model test and agent transport surfaces.

nodes.label: CLI runtime control
nodes.summary: The space CLI discovers command modules and controls serve, supervise, get/set, update, user, group, help, and version workflows.

nodes.label: Runtime parameter system
nodes.summary: commands/params.yaml and runtime helpers resolve launch args, stored .env values, process env, defaults, and frontend exposure.

nodes.label: Desktop packaging host
nodes.summary: Electron packaging keeps the native host thin while owning desktop startup, userData, webview bridge, updater, and release artifacts.

nodes.label: Git-backed time travel
nodes.summary: Optional writable-layer Git history supports admin/user rollback, preview, revert, and time-travel workflows.

nodes.label: Security and ownership boundaries
nodes.summary: Auth, sessions, file permissions, user crypto, quotas, and backend-only secrets enforce multi-user and shared-state boundaries.

nodes.label: Documentation-first contract
nodes.source_location: AGENTS.md; app/AGENTS.md; server/AGENTS.md; commands/AGENTS.md; packaging/AGENTS.md; tests/AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: AGENTS.md hierarchy and supplemental docs are runtime contracts that must move with code changes.

nodes.label: Test harness system
nodes.summary: Repo tests cover browser harnesses, prompt/runtime behavior, server clusters, packaging, commands, quotas, and regression surfaces.
